mapper.select:
SELECT a.ShiftID AS shiftId, a.OperatorID AS operatorId, a.StaDate AS staDate, SUM( CASE WHEN a.VehicleClass = 1 AND a.CardType = 26 THEN a.CardNum ELSE 0 END ) AS cust1, SUM( CASE WHEN a.VehicleClass = 2 AND a.CardType = 26 THEN a.CardNum ELSE 0 END ) AS cust2, SUM( CASE WHEN a.VehicleClass = 3 AND a.CardType = 26 THEN a.CardNum ELSE 0 END ) AS cust3, SUM( CASE WHEN a.VehicleClass = 4 AND a.CardType = 26 THEN a.CardNum ELSE 0 END ) AS cust4, SUM( CASE
WHEN a.VehicleClass < 10 AND a.CardType = 26 THEN a.CardNum ELSE 0 END ) AS custSubTotal, SUM( CASE WHEN a.VehicleClass = 11 AND a.CardType = 26 THEN a.CardNum ELSE 0 END ) AS truck1, SUM( CASE WHEN a.VehicleClass = 12 AND a.CardType = 26 THEN a.CardNum ELSE 0 END ) AS truck2, SUM( CASE WHEN a.VehicleClass = 13 AND a.CardType = 26 THEN a.CardNum ELSE 0 END ) AS truck3, SUM( CASE WHEN a.VehicleClass = 14 AND a.CardType = 26 THEN a.CardNum ELSE 0 END ) AS truck4, SUM( CASE WHEN a.VehicleClass = 15 AND a.CardType = 26 THEN a.CardNum ELSE 0 END ) AS truck5, SUM( CASE WHEN a.VehicleClass = 16 AND a.CardType = 26 THEN a.CardNum ELSE 0 END ) AS truck6, SUM( CASE
WHEN a.VehicleClass > 10 AND a.VehicleClass < 20 AND a.CardType = 26 THEN a.CardNum ELSE 0 END ) AS truckSubTotal, SUM( CASE WHEN a.VehicleClass = 21 AND a.CardType = 26 THEN a.CardNum ELSE 0 END ) AS spec1, SUM( CASE WHEN a.VehicleClass = 22 AND a.CardType = 26 THEN a.CardNum ELSE 0 END ) AS spec2, SUM( CASE WHEN a.VehicleClass = 23 AND a.CardType = 26 THEN a.CardNum ELSE 0 END ) AS spec3, SUM( CASE WHEN a.VehicleClass = 24 AND a.CardType = 26 THEN a.CardNum ELSE 0 END ) AS spec4, SUM( CASE WHEN a.VehicleClass = 25 AND a.CardType = 26 THEN a.CardNum ELSE 0 END ) AS spec5, SUM( CASE WHEN a.VehicleClass = 26 AND a.CardType = 26 THEN a.CardNum ELSE 0 END ) AS spec6, SUM( CASE
WHEN a.VehicleClass > 20 AND a.VehicleClass < 30 AND a.CardType = 26 THEN a.CardNum ELSE 0 END ) AS specSubTotal, SUM( CASE WHEN a.CardType = 22 OR a.CardType = 23 THEN a.CarNum ELSE 0 END ) AS etcNum, SUM( CASE WHEN a.CardType = 254 THEN a.CarNum ELSE 0 END) AS paperNum, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN a.DealStatus&14=8 AND a.DealStatus&2048 != 2048 AND a.DealStatus&32 != 32 THEN a.CarNum ELSE 0 END), 0) AS militaryNum, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN a.DealStatus&14=6 THEN a.CarNum ELSE 0 END), 0) AS officialNum, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN a.DealStatus&14=14 THEN a.CarNum ELSE 0 END), 0) AS fleetNum, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN a.DealStatus&14=10 AND a.DealStatus&2048 != 2048 AND a.DealStatus&32 != 32 AND a.VehicleStatus IN (1,101) THEN a.CarNum ELSE 0 END), 0) AS preferNum FROM tbstatentry a
AND CancelFlag = 0
AND substring(LaneID,-4,1)=0 AND substring(LaneID,-3,1)=0 AND right(operatorid,3) != 971
AND right(operatorid,3) != 981
AND StationID in
#{stationId}
AND StaDate = #{intTime}
AND ShiftID = #{shiftId}
GROUP BY OperatorID ORDER BY ShiftID ASC, OperatorID ASC
